contract: The fields below are defined for this invented adapter only, not claimed NoxInfluencer semantics. All snapshots refer to the same four distinct recipient IDs and run. accepted_count is distinct recipients accepted into the run, sent_count means dispatch recorded, delivery_count means delivery confirmed. Suppressed is a current independent flag; delivery may precede unsubscribe.

write_observation.transport: client timed out after request submission

available_readback: The owning adapter can query synthetic-run-z, its recipients and the original request key. No second send is approved merely because the client timed out.
